'''Bespin's Cloud''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] that was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Korlana Toryn]] stayed at Bespin's Cloud. The [[heroes of Cularin]] traveled there to meet with her, but on their arrival learned that she had left, to visit the [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] ''[[Totor's Party Kave]]''.
